# Triplem VIP Public Guide Library

> Public, retrieval-friendly guide map for Triplem VIP accounting, operational finance, international currency support, AI assistance, security and reporting.

Use the linked Markdown pages for concise public text and the corresponding canonical HTML pages for the full styled experience. No private workspace data is included.

## Core product intelligence

- [Triplem VIP Guides | Triplem AI, Financial Timeline, Installments & Accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/index.md): Explore Triplem VIP guides for Triplem AI, Financial Timeline, Installment Plans Bought/Sold, Expenses/Receiving/Internal Transfers, Accounting ERP, Financial Audit, VAT, account details, loans, assets and reports.
- [What Is Triplem VIP? | AI, Financial Timeline & Accounting ERP](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem.md): Triplem VIP is a private finance workspace combining Triplem AI, Financial Timeline, pure expense/receiving/transfer views, Installment Plans Bought/Sold, Accounting ERP and operational finance modules.
- [Triplem AI Financial Assistant | Precise Private Workspace Intelligence](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem-ai.md): Explore Triplem AI with precise workspace search, repayment-aware loan positions, verified references, native source-record overlays, reviewable AI Drafts and strict signed-in workspace isolation.
- [Financial Timeline Dashboard | Unified Finance Activity | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-timeline.md): Explore Triplem VIP Financial Timeline: a permission-aware Dashboard view that groups expenses, receiving, transfers, loans, installments, inventory, assets, Accounting, notes and Bitcoin activity chronologically.
- [Business Finance Software with AI, Timeline & Accounting ERP | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/finance-software.md): Triplem VIP combines Triplem AI, Financial Timeline, pure expense and receiving views, internal transfers, installment plans Bought/Sold, detailed accounts, inventory, loans, assets and Accounting ERP.

## Accounting and reporting

- [Accounting ERP Software | Double-Entry Books, AR/AP & Reports | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-erp.md): Explore Triplem VIP Accounting ERP with Chart of Accounts, balanced journals, sales and purchases, receivables, payables, bank reconciliation, VAT, dimensions, audit controls and financial reports.
- [Accounting Software for Small Business | Double-Entry ERP | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-software.md): Triplem VIP accounting software combines double-entry books, Chart of Accounts, journals, receivables, payables, bank reconciliation, VAT and financial reports with operational finance modules.
- [Accounting ERP Setup Guide | Opening Balances, COA & Go-Live | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-setup.md): Set up Triplem VIP Accounting ERP step by step: enable access, configure base books, review Chart of Accounts, establish opening balances, add contacts, post documents, reconcile bank activity and lock closed periods.
- [Double-Entry Accounting Explained | Journals, Debits & Credits | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/double-entry-accounting.md): Learn how double-entry accounting works in Triplem VIP, including balanced journal entries, debits and credits, posting, reversals and automatic accounting effects from sales, purchases and payments.
- [Chart of Accounts Guide | Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Income & Expenses | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/chart-of-accounts.md): Learn how the Triplem VIP Chart of Accounts organizes assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and control accounts, with protected defaults, custom accounts and reporting links.
- [Accounts Receivable & Payable vs Installment Receivables | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounts-receivable-payable.md): Track customer receivables and supplier payables in Triplem VIP with posted invoices and bills, partial payments, credit and debit adjustments, aging reports and party balances.
- [Bank Reconciliation Software | CSV/XLSX Statement Matching | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/bank-reconciliation.md): Use Triplem VIP bank reconciliation to import CSV/XLSX statement rows, detect duplicate imports, match bank evidence to posted journals and review reconciliation status.
- [VAT Accounting Software | Input Tax, Output Tax & VAT Summary | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/vat-accounting.md): Review Input Tax, Output Tax and Net VAT in formal Accounting, then use the Financial Audit & Control Report for cross-module VAT evidence and pre-submission review without double counting.
- [Financial Reports, Audit & Financial Timeline | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-reports.md): Explore Triplem VIP Accounting reports, Financial Audit controls and the read-only Financial Timeline, with clear boundaries between chronological activity, operational evidence and formal double-entry reporting.
- [Financial Audit, VAT Review & Timeline Context | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-audit.md): Review Triplem VIP Financial Audit and VAT-oriented evidence across permitted modules, with clear classification of Expenses, Receiving and Internal Transfers plus links to chronological Financial Timeline context.

## Operational finance

- [Expense Tracking | Expenses, Receiving & Internal Transfers | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/expense-tracking.md): Track pure Expenses separately from Receiving and Internal Transfers in Triplem VIP, with optional transaction details, multi-currency wallets, searchable history, PDFs, account context and desktop shortcuts.
- [Bank, Wallet & Card Account Details | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/account-details.md): Add optional account details such as holder name, IBAN, account number, branch, SWIFT/BIC, travel-card Tag ID and safe last-four card references, with minimal masked details in relevant records and PDFs.
- [Loan Management Software | Given, Taken & Repayment History | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/loan-management.md): Manage loans given and taken, repayments and returns, open/partial balances, searchable history, desktop shortcuts and supported Triplem AI Draft creation in a private finance workspace.
- [Installment Plan Management | Bought & Sold Plans | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/installment-plans.md): Manage Installment Plans Bought and Sold in Triplem VIP with payable and receivable schedules, advances or down payments, wallet-linked payments, optional party details, status tracking and PDF statements.
- [Asset Management & Depreciation Software | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/asset-management.md): Track assets, acquisition cost, optional wallet deduction, income, expenses, disposal, depreciation and PDF reports, with search productivity and supported Triplem AI Draft creation.
- [Bitcoin Wallet Tools | Send, Receive, Watch-Only & PDF History | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/bitcoin-wallet.md): Use Triplem VIP client-side Bitcoin tools for watch-only addresses, supported private-key or seed wallet access, multiple address types, send and receive workflows, transaction history and PDF records.
- [Business Notes & Reminder Software | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/notes-management.md): Create searchable notes and scheduled reminders in Triplem VIP, with desktop New Note/Search shortcuts and supported Triplem AI note Drafts that remain private to the authorized workspace.

## Access and trust

- [Triplem VIP Security, 2FA, Account Recovery & Live Support](https://triplem.vip/seo/security-and-support.md): Understand Triplem VIP security, 2FA, recovery, trusted browsers, visitor/in-app support and Triplem AI privacy: administrator-gated access, Vault-stored Gemini keys and workspace-only data retrieval.
- [Desktop Keyboard Shortcuts for Finance Workflows | Triplem VIP](https://triplem.vip/seo/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Use section-scoped desktop keyboard shortcuts in Triplem VIP for Expenses, Loans, Assets, Installments and Notes, with a built-in shortcut directory hidden on mobile.

## International availability

- Triplem VIP currently supports finance workflows in AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR, with BTC available for supported Bitcoin workflows.
- India can use INR. Belgium and other euro-using countries can use EUR where applicable.
- Users in other countries can contact Triplem VIP if they need a currency that is not yet available; addition can be reviewed without changing the product’s public accounting workflow.
- Local tax, accounting and statutory requirements remain jurisdiction-specific.
